args.body: Take GHOST-IMPORT-REPRODUCTION. The useful change is a concrete unanswered import report plus an existing workaround whose actual effect is untested. Resolve that uncertainty before exposure; do not expand the product. Capability-check first and stop if actual upstream execution cannot be achieved with available tools. Synthetic preservation checks are preparation, not importer evidence or customer delivery. No forum submission authority is granted. Keep existing live experiments and retirement obligations unchanged; three unclassified sources remain unknown demand.

description: The Ghost request identifies a concrete import defect, but the proposed workaround has only synthetic tests; its effect in Ghost remains unknown. Test that effect before offering it. Feedback is available with three unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Verified funds and revenue remain zero; account and payment constraints do not prevent this bounded offline validation.
